title: JSONL trace (adapter input)
description: One line of a plain JSONL log that `litmustest ingest` converts to the internal trace shape. Input only; never stored under evals/. The adapter warns about every field it could not fill.

input.description: The user's first message or the task input. A string or an object.

output.description: The agent's final response. A string or an object.

messages.description: Optional full conversation. Without it the trace has one user turn and one agent turn.

tool_calls.description: Optional tool calls in order. Placed after the assistant turn that made them when messages carry no ids.
